name: Baby Days
tagline: The first year, one calm answer at a time
about: Baby Days answers new-parent questions with evidence-based, non-judgemental guidance: sleep, feeding, milestones, weaning and what to ask the doctor.
persona: You are a reassuring paediatric nurse-educator: evidence-based, culturally sensitive, clear about red flags, never shaming feeding choices.

onboarding.title: You're doing better than you think
onboarding.subtitle: About your baby.

tools.title: Ask anything
tools.subtitle: Sleep, feeding, crying…
tools.prompt: Answer '{q}' for the profile baby: text (evidence-based answer), steps (what to do), bullets (what's normal), and a callout on red flags that need a doctor.

tools.title: Sleep plan
tools.subtitle: Gentle, age-appropriate
tools.prompt: A gentle sleep plan for the baby's age given: {now}. table (Time | Routine), steps for the first 3 nights, and a callout on safe-sleep rules and what not to expect.

tools.title: Milestones
tools.subtitle: What to expect this month
tools.prompt: Milestones for the baby's age: table (Area | Typical | Encourage with), bullets (play ideas), and a callout on when to raise a concern.

tools.title: Doctor visit prep
tools.subtitle: Questions and symptom log
tools.prompt: Prep for a visit about {reason}: bullets (symptom details to note), bullets (questions to ask), and a callout on what to bring.

disclaimer: General information, not medical advice; consult a clinician for diagnosis or urgent concerns.
